title: When attachment keeps tightening the grip under pressure
issueStatement: The mind keeps clinging to what it cannot finally keep. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru teaches love without possession and steadiness without denial. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Freedom is not numbness. It is steadiness before what usually hooks the mind. Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it.
actionPrompt: Practice holding the gift without claiming authorship over it. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
